name: Laurie Speed
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Laurie Speed is a trial attorney and co-founder of Speed & King, where she proudly represents seriously injured people and their families. Her primary practice areas include medical malpractice, auto accidents and premises liability.
